description: Write and export one small pure function: sum the multiples of 3 or 5 below n.

input.assignment: Write an Agency module that exports def sumMultiples(n: number): number, returning the sum of all positive multiples of 3 or 5 that are strictly below n. A number that is a multiple of both counts once. For n <= 3 there are no such multiples, so the result is 0. Examples: sumMultiples(10) = 23 (3 + 5 + 6 + 9), sumMultiples(20) = 78. Use only Agency standard library (std::) imports, or no imports at all.
